headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 2, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up with several teams securing convincing victories. The Orioles, Guardians, Nationals, Tigers, Pirates, and Reds all emerged victorious in their respective matchups.

Top MLB news saw the Orioles cruise past the White Sox 6-1, with Dean Kremer earning the win. The Guardians also secured a convincing 9-4 victory over the Rangers, led by Austin Hedges' strong performance at the plate. The Nationals dominated the Red Sox 10-2, with James Wood leading the charge. The Tigers took down the Yankees 6-2, with Keider Montero earning the win, while the Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Phillies. The Reds completed the day's wins with a 7-2 victory over the Brewers.

Injuries have started to impact several teams, with the Giants placing Matt Chapman on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The Royals have also been affected, with Kris Bubic and Connor Seabold joining the injured list. The Rangers, Tigers, Red Sox, Marlins, and Astros have also suffered injuries to key players.

Roster movement has been minimal, with several trades taking place. The Nationals acquired Kyle Nicolas from the Orioles in exchange for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded Ben Hansen to the Red Sox for Brett Harris. The Rangers traded Ben Hartl to the White Sox for Ben Peoples. The Giants traded Buddy Kennedy to the Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Orioles Cruise Past White Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dean Kremer earning the win. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Guardians Cruise Past Rangers 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a convincing 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Austin Hedges leading the charge at the plate. Hedges hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Joey Cantillo earned the win with 5 strong innings on the mound.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, led by strong performances from their impact hitters. Jared Jones was instrumental in the win, contributing to the Pirates' success.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included TJ Friedl and Dane Myers, while Jacob Misiorowski stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Matt Chapman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The move was made on July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
